basics.name: Armiel Pillay
basics.label: Final-year Applied Mathematics & Computer Science undergraduate.
basics.summary: I'm an open-source software engineer who bridges the gap between complex problems and real-world solutions through lightweight, high-performance software. My work includes developing AxOS, a Linux–based operating system used by thousands of people worldwide, building financial tools that entrepreneurs rely on every day, and creating the software infrastructure that powers scholastic chess across South Africa. I believe great software should be fast, intuitive, and dependable—whether it's powering an operating system, supporting businesses, or serving communities.
